stories.headline: Anthropic IPO timing faces investor doubts
stories.summary: Reuters sources say investors want a lower valuation and question Anthropic's planned November IPO timetable after the AI-stock selloff. Anthropic declined comment; no delay has been confirmed.

stories.headline: State AG election wins could reshape US litigation
stories.summary: Democrats won attorney general offices in Georgia, Iowa, Ohio, Kansas and Texas. Pending abortion, immigration and environmental cases could change direction, but withdrawals or new legal outcomes are not yet established.

stories.headline: Aramco building damaged after attempted Riyadh attack
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry reports limited debris damage to an Aramco administrative building in Riyadh and no casualties. The coalition reports missile interceptions; the Houthis had not immediately commented.

stories.headline: Zaporizhzhia loses external power again
stories.summary: The IAEA and plant management say Zaporizhzhia is using backup generators for cooling after losing external power. The cause is unknown. The IAEA reports roughly two weeks' fuel for a limited number of generators.

stories.headline: New Zealand awaits decisive final election count
stories.summary: Preliminary results give the governing coalition a narrow majority, while National and Labour are nearly tied in popular votes. Special votes could change the outcome; final results are due November 27.
